name: Delete / cleanup test calendar event
description: test-user-01 deletes the test calendar event created by SCN-CALENDAR-001 (and optionally updated by SCN-CALENDAR-002). This scenario exists primarily as a cleanup step for the calendar pack; it is reversible only in the sense that the event can be re-created by re-running SCN-CALENDAR-001.
correlation_strategy: Deletes only the event matching the correlation token from the scenario evidence record. Never deletes events from other scenarios or unrelated calendar entries.
notes: destructive=false because the deletion is scoped to a scenario-created artifact. The risk remains LOW.
